full_judgment: 2. Opposite parties’ No. 1-6 as plaintiffs filed the said Suit in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Sylhet for partition impleading the present petitioner as defendant No. 1 along with others. It appears that the plaintiffs claimed their saham in the suit land to the extent of 1/8th share from two plots being No. 7080 and 7102 of Chhapa Khatian No. 3159 (ছাপা খতিয়ান) through one Abdus Sobhan as their predecessor-in-interest on declaration of their title. In the said suit the present petitioner appeared and filed an application under Order VII, rule II along with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure (the Code) for rejection of the plaint on the ground that previously one Rokeya Banu and others as plaintiffs filed partition Suit No. 206 of 1970 in the same Court impleading Abdus Sobhan, the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs along with others as defendants for partition of the estate of Hajee Abdur Rahman, the predecessor-in-interest of both the plaintiffs and the defendants. Further the present plaintiffs got themselves added in the said Suit as defendants Nos. 8-13 claiming to be the heirs of late Abdus Sobhan and filed written statement. In the said Suit saham was given to Abdus Sobhan who was defendant No. 2 and after his death present defendants Nos. 1 and 2 filed application for substituting them in his place and accordingly, they were substituted as defendants No. 2(ka) and 2 (kha) and the share allotted to said Abdus Sobhan was allotted to them. After the Suit was decreed in preliminary form on 27-12-73 final decree was passed on 29-5- 98 on the basis of the commissioner's report submit- ted on 7-4-88. In the application it was further stated that in the said partition Suit the present plaintiffs filed an application praying for giving them saham of the share of Abdus Sobhan but the court by its order dated 20-12-1988 rejected the prayer. Against the said rejection of their prayer for saham as well as the final decree respectively the plaintiffs did neither file any appeal nor moved the higher court, therefore, the instant Suit filed by them in respect of the self-same Suit property after long time was barred by limitation and the plaint was liable to be rejected.
